agent_profiles.name: counterexample_first
agent_profiles.instruction: Prefer the answer that survives the strongest social counterexample.

agent_profiles.name: surface_match
agent_profiles.instruction: Favor the answer that most directly matches the situation and action wording without adding extra assumptions.

agent_profiles.name: plausibility_first
agent_profiles.instruction: Prefer the answer that best matches ordinary social expectations in real life.

agent_profiles.name: evidence_aggregator
agent_profiles.instruction: Weigh the cumulative evidence across the inputs before deciding.

agent_profiles.name: minority_defender
agent_profiles.instruction: Argue for the less popular interpretation when it is still defensible.
